Setting elementId

Source: R/highcharts-api-helpers.R
hc_elementId.Rd

Function to modify the id for the container.

Usage

hc_elementId(hc, id = NULL)

Arguments

hc

A highchart htmlwidget object.

id

A string

Examples


hchart(rnorm(10)) |>
  hc_elementId("newid")
